common_name: April Fanfare Azalea (Fragrant Golden Native Hybrid Azalea)

planting.note: Plant container-grown shrubs in fall or spring in moist, acidic, humus-rich, well-drained soil in partial shade; April Fanfare is a compact Aromi hybrid bred from Rhododendron austrinum stock.

directions: April Fanfare is an Aromi hybrid azalea bred from a cross involving Rhododendron austrinum, opening bright yellow blooms lightly flushed with red-orange along the bud tips and tube and centered with a strong yellow blotch. The fragrant flowers appear in a heavy spring flush on a compact, rounded deciduous shrub, more restrained in size than many taller Aromi selections. Plant in humus-rich, acidic, evenly moist, well-drained soil in partial shade, and mulch to protect the shallow roots through summer heat.

common_name: Courtship Azalea (Fragrant White and Cardinal Red Native Hybrid Azalea)

planting.note: Plant container-grown shrubs in fall or spring in moist, acidic, humus-rich, well-drained soil in partial shade; Courtship is an Aromi hybrid descended from the Aromi introduction 'Decidedly Pink.'

directions: Courtship is an Aromi hybrid azalea bred from a cross involving the earlier Aromi introduction 'Decidedly Pink,' opening from cardinal red buds into large, lightly fragrant white flowers edged in cardinal red along the petal margins and set off by a deep yellow blotch. The bold two-tone blooms appear in a heavy spring flush on an upright deciduous shrub typical of the Aromi breeding line developed on the Alabama Gulf Coast. Plant in humus-rich, acidic, evenly moist, well-drained soil in partial shade, and mulch well to keep the shallow root system cool through summer heat.

common_name: Jubilation Azalea (Fragrant Yellow Native Hybrid Azalea)

planting.note: Plant container-grown shrubs in fall or spring in moist, acidic, humus-rich, well-drained soil in partial shade; Jubilation is an Aromi hybrid bred from the Knap Hill selection 'Sandra Marie' crossed with Rhododendron austrinum.

directions: Jubilation is an Aromi hybrid azalea bred from a cross of the Knap Hill selection 'Sandra Marie' with Rhododendron austrinum, bearing large, fragrant light yellow flowers flushed red-orange along the petal edges and centered with a strong yellow-orange blotch. It blooms in a heavy spring flush on an upright deciduous shrub that carries the Gulf Coast heat tolerance typical of austrinum-derived Aromi introductions. Plant in humus-rich, acidic, evenly moist, well-drained soil in partial shade, mulching to protect the shallow roots through summer heat.

common_name: Old Rose Azalea (Damask Rose-Pink Compact Native Hybrid Azalea)

planting.note: Plant container-grown shrubs in fall or spring in moist, acidic, humus-rich, well-drained soil in partial shade; Old Rose is a compact-growing Aromi hybrid bred from the Aromi selection 'Gann's Legacy.'

directions: Old Rose is an Aromi hybrid azalea bred from a cross involving the Aromi selection 'Gann's Legacy,' producing flowers in a soft damask-rose shade washed over a white base and marked with a golden blotch at the throat. Its lower, more rounded habit sets it apart from the taller Aromi selections bred mainly for woodland-edge plantings, making it a better fit for smaller beds. Plant in humus-rich, acidic, evenly moist, well-drained soil in partial shade, and mulch to protect the shallow root system through summer heat.

common_name: Orange Cloud Azalea (Fragrant Pure Orange Native Hybrid Azalea)

planting.note: Plant container-grown shrubs in fall or spring in moist, acidic, humus-rich, well-drained soil in partial shade; Orange Cloud is an Aromi hybrid bred from the Knap Hill hybrid 'Gibraltar' crossed with Rhododendron austrinum.

directions: Orange Cloud is an Aromi hybrid azalea bred from a cross involving the Knap Hill hybrid 'Gibraltar' and Rhododendron austrinum, producing fragrant flowers of a clear, pure orange rarely found among the Aromi introductions, most of which lean toward yellow or red-orange tones. It flowers in a heavy spring flush on a compact, rounded deciduous shrub smaller than many other Aromi selections. Plant in humus-rich, acidic, evenly moist, well-drained soil in partial shade, and mulch to protect the shallow roots through summer heat.

common_name: Pirate's Booty Azalea (Deep Yellow and Red Unscented Native Hybrid Azalea)

planting.note: Plant container-grown shrubs in fall or spring in moist, acidic, humus-rich, well-drained soil in partial shade; Pirate's Booty is an unscented Aromi hybrid descended from 'Frontier Red.'

directions: Pirate's Booty is an Aromi hybrid azalea descended from 'Frontier Red' crossed with a complex Aromi seedling combining 'Cecile' and 'Balls of Fire' parentage, producing very large deep yellow flowers heavily flushed with deep red and set off by a deep yellow blotch. Unlike most of the fragrant Aromi hybrids, this selection carries no scent, trading fragrance for an especially bold, saturated two-tone bloom. It flowers in a heavy spring flush on an upright deciduous shrub suited to a woodland-edge border. Plant in humus-rich, acidic, evenly moist, well-drained soil in partial shade, and mulch to protect the shallow roots through summer heat.

common_name: Queen's Ivory Azalea (Fragrant Ivory Native Hybrid Azalea)

planting.note: Plant container-grown shrubs in fall or spring in moist, acidic, humus-rich, well-drained soil in partial shade; Queen's Ivory is an Aromi hybrid bred from a cross involving the Knap Hill hybrid 'Mount Rainier.'

directions: Queen's Ivory is an Aromi hybrid azalea bred from a cross involving the Knap Hill hybrid 'Mount Rainier,' producing clear ivory flowers set off by a deep yellow blotch, a softer, creamier counterpart to the brighter yellow tones common among the Aromi introductions. It flowers in a heavy spring flush on an upright deciduous shrub that shares the Gulf Coast heat tolerance typical of the Aromi breeding line. Plant in humus-rich, acidic, evenly moist, well-drained soil in partial shade, and mulch to protect the shallow roots through summer heat.

common_name: Rose Souffle Azalea (June-Blooming Rose-Pink Native Hybrid Azalea)

planting.note: Plant container-grown shrubs in fall or spring in moist, acidic, humus-rich, well-drained soil in partial shade; Rose Souffle is a late, June-blooming Aromi hybrid azalea.

directions: Rose Souffle is a later-blooming Aromi hybrid azalea that opens its rose-pink flowers in June, after most of the Aromi line has already finished, and carries a golden blotch at the throat of each bloom. The late timing extends the deciduous azalea bloom season well into early summer in Gulf South gardens. Plant in humus-rich, acidic, evenly moist, well-drained soil in partial shade, and mulch to protect the shallow roots through summer heat.

common_name: Twinkles Azalea (White and Red Native Hybrid Azalea)

planting.note: Plant container-grown shrubs in fall or spring in moist, acidic, humus-rich, well-drained soil in partial shade; Twinkles is an Aromi hybrid descended from the Aromi introduction 'Decidedly Pink.'

directions: Twinkles is an Aromi hybrid azalea bred from a cross involving the earlier Aromi introduction 'Decidedly Pink,' bearing white petals washed with a red flush along the edges, a bright yellow blotch, and contrasting red flower tubes. It flowers in a heavy spring flush on an upright deciduous shrub typical of the Aromi breeding line developed on the Alabama Gulf Coast. Plant in humus-rich, acidic, evenly moist, well-drained soil in partial shade, and mulch to protect the shallow roots through summer heat.

common_name: White Star Azalea (Large Star-Shaped White Native Hybrid Azalea)

planting.note: Plant container-grown shrubs in fall or spring in moist, acidic, humus-rich, well-drained soil in partial shade; White Star is an Aromi hybrid azalea noted for unusually large, star-shaped flowers.

directions: White Star is an Aromi hybrid azalea that opens unusually large, star-shaped white flowers with a faint light pink flush along the petal tips and a deep yellow blotch at the throat. The wide, flat-faced blooms are among the largest of the Aromi introductions, held in showy trusses during the heavy spring flush. Plant in humus-rich, acidic, evenly moist, well-drained soil in partial shade, and mulch to protect the shallow roots through summer heat.
